title: security-rbac-v2-kms-region-residency-audit-hardening
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS region residency and improve audit coverage for cross-region KMS usage. This change closes gaps found during a compliance review (SEC-421) where RBAC policies allowed KMS keys to be referenced without explicit region residency checks and audit events were not emitted consistently for fallback KMS behavior. Goals: 1) Enforce region pinning at policy evaluation time for RBAC v2; 2) Emit structured audit events for KMS selection and any cross-region fallbacks; 3) Validate region tags during private-installer run and surface clear CLI/runtime errors; 4) Add end-to-end integration tests and docs. Summary of changes: - Add region residency enforcement to rbac policy enforcer with an opt-in enforcement flag for gradual rollout. The enforcer now validates requester/resource region attributes and denies requests that violate customer-configured residency policies. - KMS residency check library added (Go) with deterministic evaluation of key residency and caching of residency metadata. - Audit pipeline changes (Rust) to emit structured events including policy_decision, kms_key_id, key_region, caller_region, evaluated_policy_id, and enforcement_mode. Events include a stable schema version header. - Installer templates and a CLI validation step were updated to ensure region tags are present for on-prem/private deployments; installer now fails fast with actionable messages when residency metadata is missing. - Docs: added a new security doc describing residency controls and migration steps for existing KMS bindings. - Tests: integration tests added to validate enforcement and audit emission; unit tests cover edge cases (missing region, ambiguous region, fallback to multi-region keys). Rollout plan: feature gated behind "rbac.v2.kms_residency.enforce" flag. Start with audit-only mode for 1 week in canary, then staged enforcement for customers with explicit policy. Monitoring: added metrics for policy_denied_count, audit_event_emit_failures, kms_residency_cache_miss_rate. Backout: enforce flag can be disabled and a migration script is provided to annotate legacy KMS bindings. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of enforcement in enforcer core - [x] Structured audit event schema defined and implemented - [x] Private-installer validation and helpful errors - [x] Integration and unit tests - [x] Docs and migration guide - [x] CI passing and security review sign-off (SEC-421)
commits: feat(rbac): add KMS region pinning enforcement and evaluation hooks
feat(kms): add residency checker library with caching and deterministic resolution (Go)
feat(audit): emit structured KMS residency audit events with schema v1 (Rust)
chore(installer): validate region tags during private installer run and fail fast with suggested fixes
docs(security): add kms-region-residency guide and migration steps
test(integration): add e2e tests for residency enforcement and audit emission
review_comments: Ethan Morales: Please ensure the residency cache has an eviction policy and that cache misses are instrumented. Also request a small doc blurb on how long metadata is considered fresh.
Priya Kapoor: Reply: Added LRU with 10k entries and TTL=24h; exported kms_residency_cache_miss_rate metric and added docs to README with freshness semantics.
Chen Li: Security review: audit event schema looks good. Please include the evaluated_policy_id and enforcement_mode explicitly in logs for forensicability.
Priya Kapoor: Reply: included evaluated_policy_id and enforcement_mode in schema and updated log_emitter tests.
Roxanne Diaz: Request changes: installer UX needs clearer error codes for missing tags so automation can detect transient vs user errors.
Priya Kapoor: Reply: added exit codes EX_CONFIG_MISSING and EX_CONFIG_INVALID and documented them in installer docs. Updated tests to assert exit codes.
Chen Li: Approve after addressing comments.
merge_details: Merged via squash by Chen Li after approvals from Ethan Morales and Roxanne Diaz. Squash commit message: 'security(rbac): enforce kms region residency + audit events (ENG-8753, SEC-421)'. Deployed to canary on 2026-02-20 behind feature gate 'rbac.v2.kms_residency.enforce' in audit-only mode.
release_notes: Enforced KMS region residency checks in RBAC v2 (opt-in enforcement flag). Emitted structured audit events for KMS selection and cross-region fallbacks (schema v1). Installer now validates region tags and fails fast with clear exit codes. Added migration script to annotate legacy bindings. Metrics added for monitoring policy denials and audit failures.
